biggest_catch: Pay is per project — not a salary and not an hourly wage: projects pay what their statement of work says (example: $7.00/hr average, $0.82 per approved hit), only APPROVED work is paid (rejected tasks earn $0), there is no guaranteed project flow, and you need a verified PayPal or Payoneer account with a $10 minimum per payment cycle.
catches: Pay is per project and varies by task complexity, language pair, and region — there is no guaranteed hourly rate or steady project flow.
Only approved tasks are eligible for compensation; rejected tasks are not paid, and quality is tracked with removal for underperformance.

Payments are monthly or per project via Payoneer (preferred) or PayPal; the minimum transferable amount per payment cycle is $10 (third-party mirror of OneForma's payment guidelines — not confirmed on a fetched official page).
Qualification tests to unlock projects are unpaid; project rates are only shown once you are accepted into a project.
Some projects ban the use of generative AI/LLM tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot) at any stage — violation means removal and no payment (per the official statement of work).
Account verification can be strict; project availability varies substantially by country/language.

steps: Register for free at oneforma.com and complete your contributor profile.
Take the (unpaid) qualification tests and surveys to unlock project eligibility — rates are only shown once accepted into a project.
Apply for projects matching your language skills and region; read each project's statement of work for its exact rate (e.g., $0.82 per approved hit, or $37.50 for a 4-video collection).
Complete tasks following the project instructions exactly — only approved work is paid, and rejected tasks earn nothing (never use generative AI tools if the project bans them).
Set up your payment details in your profile: Payoneer is preferred; PayPal is accepted for smaller payments. Payments process monthly or per project once you meet the payment-cycle minimum.
timing: Paid monthly or per project once payment-cycle minimums are met ($10 minimum per cycle reported by a third-party mirror of OneForma's payment guidelines).
